title: Shared reference model of a financial event
purpose: Names the parts that one financial event connects: the authority, the rule, the input and output records, the classification, the system, the balance that changes and the delivered output. It gives the terms that the research registers use.
not_in_a_chapter: It is a proposal for a data model, not a description of Philippine PFM from a source.

title: Reconciliation across budget, accounting, bank and physical evidence
purpose: A proposed way to sort the differences that a reconciliation finds: differences of timing, of classification, of a missing link between records, and irregularities.
not_in_a_chapter: It is a proposed procedure. The atlas describes the differences themselves in chapter A0, section 4, and the reconciliations that the Manual requires in chapter A4.

title: Revenue administration beyond collecting tax
purpose: The steps of revenue administration before and after a collection: registration, declaration or assessment, arrears and enforcement, matching of records, refunds and adjustments.
not_in_a_chapter: The atlas has no source for these steps in the rules of BIR and BOC. Chapter E5, section 4, describes the collections and the refunds that the sources cover.

title: Entity and funding channel variants
purpose: The kinds of public body whose money follows other rules than a national agency: local governments, government corporations, government financial institutions, the Bangsamoro region, and special funds.
not_in_a_chapter: Two of these kinds, the government financial institutions and the Bangsamoro region, are not covered by the atlas, and the diagram names no source for them.

title: IFMIS implementation is not equivalent to an interface
purpose: A method to grade a statement that two information systems exchange data: from a planned interface to an interface that is shown to work, with the evidence that each grade needs.
not_in_a_chapter: It is a method. The register of interfaces in Reference B uses its own classification: carrier, stage of use and the check of both sides.

title: IFMIS interface failure and duplicate entry pattern
purpose: The pattern of an exchange between two systems that fails: a record that is missing, duplicated, old, different or in the wrong period, and the owner who must correct it.
not_in_a_chapter: It is a general pattern, not a description of an exchange that a source documents.

title: UACS code revisions and crosswalk controls
purpose: A proposed control for comparing data that use two versions of the UACS codes: a versioned mapping, and the checks for codes that are split, merged or removed.
not_in_a_chapter: It is a proposal. Chapter UACS describes the structure of the code. The sources that the atlas read name a review of UACS, and no procedure for comparing versions.

title: Typed financial records with stable IDs and versioned classification
purpose: A proposed data schema for typed financial records with stable identifiers and versioned classification. It is the schema behind the research registers.
not_in_a_chapter: It is a proposal for a data model, not a description of Philippine PFM from a source.
